dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm trying to figure out what the kids from the desert might enjoy. Would they prefer snacks or toys...?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Do you have some time to help me out?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm. A colleague of mine left the Akademiya some time ago to return to the desert as a teacher. I received a missive from her the other day.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: She was wondering if I had any interest in paying her a visit, and perhaps holding a few literacy classes for the students...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's great! You'll finally have some new students!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Haha, so you haven't forgotten about my wish.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: But the point of this trip would be to just help them learn to read some of the most commonly used words.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: We want to make reading easier for them so they can hopefully discover more interests on their own.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: If some of the seeds that we plant today can take root and grow into lofty trees in the future, that is enough for me.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Whether they choose to pursue the same field of research as me is a separate matter... Ultimately, it will all depend on their natural aptitude.

choices.text: You're hoping that some of them do, right?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Hmph, look at you, trying to figure me out. Do I detect someone is getting a little too big for their boots?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: There's no point in teaching you a different kind of lesson right this moment, though. I still need time to finish some prep...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: It just came back to me. A little while ago, the Akademiya announced a new set of rules for off-site teaching. Every instructor must fill out a whole set of application forms.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Oh well, to the ends of the ruins with that. When they find me out, I'll just say my memory failed me. It's not like they can do anything to me.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Planning for my visit to the desert is far more important. Why don't you come with me to pick out some gifts? Snacks and toys... Let's get a good selection of both.

choices.text: Surely you'll get at least ONE new student from this?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Hmph, look at you, trying to take a dig at me. Do I detect someone is getting a little too big for their boots?
